whenToUse: A league table, ladder or leaderboard ranked by points — sports, esports, quiz or debating leagues, sales contests.
A compact top-N table that always includes the viewer's own side.
avoidWhen: Sortable, filterable business data — use data-table.
A single score or KPI — use stat.
a11y: A captioned table with row headers; short headers (P, W, Pts) are announced by their full names.
The highlighted side has aria-current and a spoken suffix; the form guide is role="img" with a full name and visible letters, so colour is never the only signal.
